text: Sybil attack risk is amplified in reputation-driven systems relative to stake-based ones, because influence derives from behavioral metrics that an attacker can mimic across many pseudonymous identities.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296

isBasedOn.name: Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse

abstract: In reputation-driven systems, this threat is amplified as influence stems from behavioral metrics rather than stake, enabling attackers to mimic legitimate activity across numerous identities

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: reputation-driven consensus systems where influence stems from behavioral metrics
